take_homes: Start with one agent. Splitting has a cost, so split only for access, dialect or stance.
The test for any multi-agent pitch: could one prompt do the same job? If yes, don't buy the split.
Handoffs between agents are where errors hide. Nothing in the module checks whether the final briefing is true.

monday.move: Ask my controller to try the month-end variance commentary with one agent, not several, and compare it with the manual version
monday.stop_condition: it misses or invents a figure, or takes longer than doing it by hand
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data

misconception.why: Nothing said what it costs per month or what a capability is worth to the company. 'Start with don't' made me more careful about spending, which fits my view that AI is something you buy, not something you build.

one_line: The 'don't split unless you must' part was sound, but I got no figures and was told to hold a doubt I couldn't test.
